name: CONTENT-PUBLIC-QUERY
status: implemented with local H2 and provider fixture; native MySQL and real User integration pending

api.visibility: published and not deleted only; draft, withdrawn, deleted and absent return HTTP 200 code 513 without body
api.pagination: pageNum default 1, pageSize default 10, max 100, max offset 10000000; categoryId <= 0 means all; invalid values HTTP 200 code 514
api.response: code/msg/data; page data contains only rows and total; Java long IDs/counts/total as decimal strings; dates yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss GMT+8
api.author: authorName and authorAvatar are null for MISSING or UNAVAILABLE; authorInfoStatus distinguishes FOUND/MISSING/UNAVAILABLE
api.counter: hot and article viewCount use persisted database values; no Redis live increment in this slice
api.authorization: Only exact listed GET routes are anonymous; spoofed identity headers rejected; client token never used as author identity or forwarded to User

userClient.unconfigured: all absent yields UNAVAILABLE; partial or invalid configuration fails startup
userClient.origin: HTTPS fixed origin with trusted JVM certificates; HTTP only literal 127.0.0.1 or ::1 loopback; no userinfo, path beyond /, query, fragment, proxy or redirects
userClient.token: POST /internal/v1/auth/service-tokens with Basic service-id:secret and audience knode-user, permissions [users:public:read]; validate bare response accessToken/tokenType/expiresIn/audience/permissions
userClient.profiles: POST /internal/v1/users/public-profiles:batch with Bearer service token and deduplicated userIds; no requests for empty list
userClient.validation: Strict user-batches-g5-v0.1 fields; extra fields, missing/extra/duplicate IDs, bad types or malformed data yield UNAVAILABLE. nickName and avatar capped at 2048 UTF-16 code units each; producer schema does not declare a maximum, so this consumer bound requires agreement.
userClient.limits: Connect 400ms, each request <=1000ms, entire two-call lookup <=2000ms; each response <=3145728 bytes; 100 IDs maximum; no retries or token cache. A 3 MiB response budget covers 100 profiles with both 2048-unit fields JSON escaped, plus envelope.
userClient.privacy: No browser token, passwords, email, raw upstream body or credential in public output or intentional logs

schema: New installs use db/content-article-schema.sql; existing R2 schemas require separately planned db/content-metadata-upgrade.sql. Neither runs automatically. Native MySQL migration is unverified.
